I have defended my PhD in [Systems Engineering](https://emse.engineering.gwu.edu/) at [George Washington University](https://www.gwu.edu/), advised by Professor [John Helveston](https://www.jhelvy.com), and the degree will be conferred in December 2026. My research uses data science and quantitative modeling to study human behavior in transportation systems. I develop open-source software for survey design and discrete choice modeling, and build full-stack research applications with {{< var rlink >}}, {{< var python >}}, {{< var quarto >}}, {{< var shiny >}}, and [PostgreSQL](https://supabase.com). With Professor Helveston, I run [Alkaline Software](https://github.com/alkaline-software), an app development studio that builds apps in Rust with [GPUI](https://www.gpui.rs). Our flagship product is [Emaki](https://emaki.lol), an Agentic Development Environment (ADE). A traditional IDE is built around editing files; Emaki is built around the coding-agent sessions that now write much of the code.
